release_notes:
Fix newsletter emoji corruption, invoice-cancel blank screen, service detail page styling

Newsletter scheduler: job tables were latin1 so the Body snapshot turned emoji into '?' on scheduled sends (test sends unaffected); migration converts tbl_gf_newsletter_jobs + tbl_gf_newsletter_job_recipients to utf8mb4. Cancel Invoice: rebateUserCredits() fataled on PHP 8 (TypeError on empty-string arithmetic) when the invoice had CreditsTransferred=0, blanking the page after the status update; guards added, covers bulk cancel and single-invoice status change. Service detail pages: rebuilt servicedtl/serverservicedtl as a white card matching the services listing with readable typography for admin-entered descriptions, delivery/price chips, themed order button, responsive.
